DT_PalFirstActivatedInfoText.PAL_FIRST_SPAWN_DESC_GrassMammoth:
Can be ridden.
While mounted, increases logging efficiency by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> and mining efficiency by <Status_Up>{Passive2_EffectValue1}%</>.
While in party, increases own Health by <Status_Up>{Passive3_EffectValue3}%</>, Attack and Defense by <Status_Up>{Passive3_EffectValue1}%</>, and damage to enemies afflicted with Ivy-Covered by <Status_Up>{Passive3_EffectValue4}%</>.
(Does not stack)
